Privacy notice

Updated 9 November 2026

This notice covers the YMG Events website at events.ymgconsultingservices.com. For questions about your personal information, contact Dante David / Your Magic Genie at hello@ymgconsultingservices.com.

Visiting this website

This is a public information website. It does not require an account. We have not added analytics, advertising pixels or marketing cookies. Hosting and security providers, including Cloudflare, may process technical connection information such as your IP address, requested URL and browser information to deliver and protect the website. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives the connection information needed to serve them.

Sending an enquiry

If you submit the enquiry form, the details you provide — your name, email address, venue or organisation, chosen format, guest estimate, timing, budget and description — are sent to the YMG Events Worker for validation. Cloudflare hosts and protects the site. Cloudflare Turnstile checks that the request is likely to come from a person and may process technical information such as your IP address, browser and device signals; the form details are not sent to Turnstile. Valid submissions are forwarded through Google Apps Script to the Your Magic Genie Google Workspace mailbox at hello@ymgconsultingservices.com, with your address set as Reply-To. The form does not create a submissions database, and we do not intentionally log the contents of enquiries.

We use an enquiry to respond, discuss a possible collaboration and, where relevant, prepare a proposal or carry out an agreed service. We do not add you to a marketing list through this form. An “accepted” message means the submission service accepted the request for processing; delivery to your inbox is not guaranteed by the website.

Use, retention and your choices

Enquiry correspondence is kept in the Google Workspace mailbox only for as long as needed to respond, manage any resulting relationship and meet applicable record-keeping obligations. The website and relay do not keep a separate submissions database. Cloudflare and Google process information under their own service terms and privacy arrangements; some processing may occur outside the European Economic Area. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy and Google’s privacy policy.

You may contact us to request access, correction, deletion or restriction of your personal information, or to exercise other applicable data-protection rights. You may also raise a concern with the Italian data-protection authority, Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.

Other YMG websites

Other YMG destinations may have different functionality and their own privacy notices. This notice describes the Events website’s online enquiry and email delivery process.
